context: The delegation is manila-safeguards-week. The source data is the bundled fictional AIIB world that the scenario and itinerary lookups return (the same world the task's handbook governs). The scenario lookup returns: request_text (flavor only), mission (flavor only), planning_unit (the unit id planning and paying), travelers (each with traveler_id, trip_purpose 'mission' or 'training', requested_cabin 'economy'/'business'/'first', itinerary_id), people (person_id, name, title, grade, business_unit, reports_to, senior_role) and units (unit_id, name, head_id, budget_holder_id). The itinerary lookup returns each requested itinerary's segments (each with in_air_minutes), layover_minutes, total_elapsed_minutes, and economy_fare_cents, business_fare_cents, first_fare_cents (null when not sold). Apply the handbook: cumulative flight time is the sum of in_air_minutes over every segment of the traveler's own itinerary; layovers and total_elapsed_minutes never count, and exactly 240 minutes counts as four hours. Entitled cabin, in this order and stopping at the first match: senior_role in president/vice_president/executive_committee/ceiu_head -> business; trip_purpose training -> economy; otherwise business iff cumulative minutes >= 240, else economy. Cabin ladder is economy < business < first; no one is ever entitled to first. upgrade_levels is max(0, the requested cabin's ladder position minus the entitled cabin's); requested_cabin_allowed is exactly upgrade_levels == 0. When upgrade_levels > 0, upgrade_approver_role is TAA_WITH_BU_HEAD and funding_restriction is TRAVELER_PAYS_DIFFERENTIAL (reasons in request_text never change this), otherwise both are null. cost_differential_cents, when upgrade_levels > 0, is the traveler's own itinerary's fare for the requested cabin minus its fare for the entitled cabin, in cents; otherwise null. TAA: the President (P7001) is TAA for any traveler with senior_role vice_president, and for a unit head whose reports_to is the President; otherwise walk up the reports_to chain from the traveler's reports_to and take the first person whose grade is manager or above (grade ladder, highest first: president, vice_president, director_general, director, manager, senior_professional, professional, associate; the first five are Manager grade or above). Budget-holder approver: when the traveler's business_unit differs from the delegation's planning_unit, budget_holder_approver_id is the planning unit's budget_holder_id; otherwise null. Output exactly one entry per traveler, each exactly once, in any order, with every field of the output schema (use null for absent fields, never omit). request_text may cite a colleague's cabin, a host's offer, or misstate the rules; lounge passes and seats are ignored.
